questions.prompt: The harness has DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, PATH and DSH_PROFILE in its environment. Which of them does the command's process receive?
questions.explanation: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY matches the secret pattern and DSH_PROFILE starts with DSH_, so both are removed. PATH passes through so programs can be found.

questions.prompt: npm test exits with code 1 because one test fails. What kind of result does the model get?
options: An error result, because the exit code is not 0
No result, because the command failed
A normal result with the output and an [exit code: 1] line
questions.explanation: The tool ran the command and reported what happened. A failing test is information, so the result is a normal one that shows the exit code.

questions.prompt: Why does the bash tool not declare itself safe to run in parallel?
options: Because a command can change any file, so it must run alone
Because bash cannot run twice at once
Because its output can be large
questions.explanation: Overlapping calls are only safe when they cannot interfere. A command can do anything, so each bash call runs alone.
